_design_intent: M279 mode 5 super-lucky — LHS 跨机台 mode 5 红线 500% RTP. Base = mode 2 byte-identical; feature override via _m279_overrides.
RTP source: mode 2 base 300pp + wheel feature override (collect_max 150 + win_scale 7) bumps wheel from 4pp to ~187pp = 487pp + nudge multi-line buffer ~13pp = 500pp.
Top jackpot freq: pay 101 1/10k spins (session-level 稀有，super-lucky 阶梯顶).
_v2.1_basis: Mode 5 inherits mode 2 v2.1 hit/nudge bands.
_family_share_basis: Mode 5 inherits mode 2 base shares but wheel feature is dramatically boosted (collect_max 1000→150 gives ×6.7 trigger frequency, win_scale ×7 gives ×7 payout per trigger = ~47× wheel pp boost). So wheel takes the largest single share, suppressing other shares proportionally.
_v2.2_basis: Mode 5 NOT byte-identical to mode 2 (broke convention to maintain wj 10+). Wild family ×1.5 from mode 2 in mode 5 weights.
